name: DrainTex Non-Woven Geotextile Fabric
description: DrainTex Geotextile Membrane Draintex is a standard duty, non-woven drainage geotextile fabric with excellent drainage and filtration properties and is avaiable in 1m x 10m, 2m x 50m, 2m x 25m, 4.5m x 11.1m and 4.5m x 100m. This drainage geo-textile fabric has a stable but open structure making it ideal for lining trenches when constructing land (French) drains. Draintex acts as a filter membrane, separating the aggregate from the soil, thus preventing the aggregate from mixing with the soil and reducing the efficiency and capacity of the drain. DrainTex is also used for wrapping soakaway and water attenuation crates in both small domestic and large commercial projects. The high permeability of the fabric means water can percolate through whilst preventing the soakaway becoming ‘silted’ up. DrainTex can be used as a ground stabilisation membrane beneath MOT Type 1 or 3 aggregate or hardcore to form a stable base in many hard landscaping and civil engineering applications. The strap-on boss provides a simple solution for fitting a 50mm copper or waste pipe to an existing 100mm cast iron soil pipe to BS 416 (pipe outside diameter min/max 109/114mm). Installation Simply determine where the waste pipe is to be positioned. Cut a 64mm hole into the cast iron soil pipe with a hole saw (the metal from the hole remains in the cutter – see tools below). Benefits of Cast Iron Non-combustible fire rated A1 Excellent acoustic properties Minimal expansion Strong and robust Excellent environmental properties Made from up to 99% recycled content 100% recyclable Long life span Timesaver Soil Coating 3m Pipes Internally lined with an ochre two-part epoxy coating Externally coated in a black acrylic paint. Fittings and couplings, Internally and externally coated in a black waterbased paint The Timesaver coating shall accept over-coating (Overpainting) with alkyd and water based paints normally used on metallic structures The Cast Iron Soil Pipe Timesaver range include heritage push-fit couplings that turns a mechanical pipe system into a system with the traditional cast iron appearance. The Timesaver Heritage couplings have been accepted by recognised bodies for all grade listed properties ie. National Heritage, English Heritage etc. Its primer black coating makes it easy to overpaint for external soil stacks, and is the perfect solution for listed buildings and those situated in areas of conservation. Prestigious commercial buildings built in the 1970’s to the mid 90’s which are serviced by cast iron soil stacks, will most likely be Timesaver. If the building is to be refurbished and changes are required, the latest Timesaver range is best suited to connect to the original pipework. Please Note: Timesaver soil fittings were traditionally supplied with a raised bead on the spigot ends, which over the years have been removed. The Heritage couplings can only be used on fittings without the bead. Manufacturer: Saint-Gobain PAM UK Product Code: 192238 Return to product list &nbsp

name: 100mm Timesaver Cast Iron Soil Pipe Strap On Boss
description: 100mm Timesaver Cast Iron Soil Pipe Strap On Boss Saint-Gobain PAM UK Cast Iron Timesaver Soil Pipe System is Available in a range of pipe diameters with an exstensive range of fittings and to suit any project. The strap-on boss provides a simple solution for fitting a 50mm copper or waste pipe to an existing 100mm cast iron soil pipe to BS 416 (pipe outside diameter min/max 109/114mm). Installation Simply determine where the waste pipe is to be positioned. Cut a 64mm hole into the cast iron soil pipe with a hole saw (the metal from the hole remains in the cutter – see tools below). Mechanically fit the boss strap in position (do not forget the rubber washer) tighten until fully secure. Insert in the waste pipe until fully seated in the boss. Tighten the boss plate to grip the rubber ‘O’ ring on the outside of the waste pipe. Tools required A 64mm hole saw: Product code 192326. name: Lindab Magestic Galvanised Steel Rectangular 210mm Flex-Fit Rafter Bracket 140mm
description: Lindab Magestic Galvanised Steel Rectangular Gutter 210mm Flex-Fit Rafter Bracket RTK21140 140mm Solid 5 mm steel bracket with flexible clips to hold the gutter in place and 4 fixing holes to secure to roof rafters Recommended 600 mm spacing, should be installed to create fall of 10 mm per 3 m run Can be bent to required angle using KBO bracket bender The Lindab Magestic Range of Rectangular gutters is an enhanced galvanised steel material for rainwater systems and standing seam applications. Lindab Magestic Steel Guttering and downpipe come with a range of benefits which you can see below. Elite Galvanisation The steel from Lindab is developed using magnesium to create a barrier to protect zincs porous structure against corrosion factors. Proven Protection Lindab have carried out Salt spray tests to illustrate the ultimate surface protection of any metallic coated steel. Magestic Galvanised Steel has more than twenty times the corrosion resistance of hot dipped galvanised steel. Reduced Coastal Corrosion Magestic corrosion is not influenced by the chlorine content of the environment. Natural exposure tests show more than three times the corrosion resistance of standard galvanisation in marine environments. Self-Healing Lindab Galvanised coatings transfer to repair red rust on cuts and scratches. Magnesium is more anodic than zinc making the sacrificial properties of Magestic more active than standard galvanisation. Lower Environmental Impact Lindab Magestic Galvanised steel is the most environmentally friendly rainwater systems on the market. Lindab Magestic Galvanised Steel has a decreased effect on zinc resources and less than 25% zinc run off into soils compared to hot dipped galvanised steel. Ages Beautifully Lindab Steel Unpainted metal gutters weather naturally organically adjusting to the environment. Magestic Galvanised steel settles to an attractive dark grey metallic appearance within 3-5 years after installation. 10 year warranty Lindab Magestic products all come with a 10 year warranty.
